transcript: did you know there's a company that does Shakespeare plays unrehearsed but they treat it like a sport judged by literal referees and basically the actors are competing to see who can mess up the fewest lines plus there's mini games a costume contest and other fun improvisational elements throughout each show you can also place bets on which actors you think will mess up the most times it's free to attend at Summit Rock in New York's Central Park And it's seriously a ton of fun this was my third year in a row attending one of these performances which are usually done toward the end of August and it's quickly become one of my favorite summer theatre traditions when I attended this year It was “unrehearsed comedy of errors” and I'm honestly obsessed with this format and all the little traditions and interactive elements that go with it it's a good reminder that some of the most inventive and communal theatrical experiences don't require a big budget or a high barrier to entry The company is called Barefoot Shakespeare and at the time that I'm posting this they have one more show this summer on August 30th at 4PM they're doing Unrehearsed a Midsummer Night’s Dream but even if you miss it this year I highly recommend keeping your eye on this company because like I said they do the unrehearsed series around this time every year and plus they do some regular main stage shows throughout the year as well
showTitle: Barefoot Shakespeare: Unrehearsed Comedy of Errors
